review_evidence: README describes EconCSLib/ as a reusable Lean library and papers/ as theorem-numbered formalizations of research papers, not merely workflow metadata.
Inspected EconCSLib/Algorithms/Complexity/Yao.lean: it proves finite Yao-style randomized lower-bound lemmas and defines a reusable randomized-payoff certificate structure.

Inspected EconCSLib/Applications/Admissions/StrategicApplication.lean: it defines strategic cutoff, payoff, and application-region primitives. The large primary manifest therefore has direct formal content and no unit-wide lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Retain EconCSLib: its reusable library and paper developments contain formal definitions and proofs in economics, computation, probability, and algorithms.
